498:         private AKRSPoint4D CalculateBondPos()
499:         {
500:             #region 贴片角度计算
501: 
502:             // 当前焊点的角度
503:             double bpAngle = this.bondPosition.CoordinateSystem.DegreeInG0() * 180.0 / Math.PI;
504: 
505:             // 角度计算 = 当前角度 + 回正角度 + 下视定位结果 + 焊点的角度 + 贴片角度硬补偿
506:             double needRotaryAngle = this.bondHeadController.GetAxisTRealPos()
507:                                      + this.bondPosition.BondPositionInfo.ComponentAngleOffSet + bpAngle
508:                                      + this.bondPosition.GetRotaryCompensate();
509: 
510:             #endregion
511: 
512:             #region 焊点所在的位置计算
513: 
514:             // 焊点XY位置硬补偿
515:             AKRSPoint3D bondPosOffset = new AKRSPoint3D(this.bondPosition.GetPositionCompensate().X, this.bondPosition.GetPositionCompensate().Y, 0);
516: 
517:             // 焊点在G0中的位置（硬补偿随角度旋转） 
518:             AKRSPoint3D bondPosAddOffset = this.bondPosition.CoordinateSystem.SelfPosToG0(bondPosOffset);
519: 
520:             // 焊后补偿
521:             AKRSPoint3D defectCompensation = DefectCompensate.GetPostBondCompensation(this.bondPosition.Name);
522: 
523:             // 单科焊点的单独补偿
524:             AKRSPoint3D singleBpCompensation = DefectCompensate.GetBpSeparateOffset(this.bondPosition);
525:    
526:             // 真实贴片的位置为焊点的焊点的位置+焊点硬补偿 - 上视的偏移值 + 温漂补偿
527:             this.realBondPositionInG0 = bondPosAddOffset + defectCompensation + singleBpCompensation;
